text:
Libre 2 is “Flash” - needed to be scanned. 
Libre 3 and 3+ are CGM (continuous)

author: Allyssa L Edwards
text: libre 2+ and Libre 3+ are cgm. libre 14 day is an fgm. ask insurance what would be covered and what the requirements are. then work with your doctor to get things phrased the right way, etc. i have low end insurance that would hardly cover anything before, particularly for T2. we had to jump through hoops just to get the original 14-day. i used that for years, then found out last year, they will cover the cgms now. i was on the 3+ for a few months  until i got my insulin pump. that is only compatible with 2+ so i had to switch.  it took a little back and forth but finally got what works for my needs.   i'm not sure what you mean by "pot" but i'd try to get specifics out of them about what is actually covered.
